'''Kajidier''' was the name of a [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt]] clan from [[Nal Hutta/Legends|Nal Hutta]].

==Description==
Kajidier was one of the [[Clans of the Ancients]], the leading [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt]] [[Kajidic/Legends|kajidics]] that could trace their ancestry back to the ancient Hutt [[Homeworld/Legends|homeworld]] [[Varl/Legends|Varl]], and was accorded the right to a seat on the [[Grand Hutt Council/Legends|Hutt Grand Council]]. The clan's primary base of operations was on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Nal Hutta/Legends|Nal Hutta]] and also held influence on the worlds [[Gamorr/Legends|Gamorr]], [[Nar Shaddaa/Legends|Nar Shaddaa]], [[Saqqar]], [[Syvris/Legends|Syvris]], and [[Ulmatra/Legends|Ulmatra]].<ref name="LoNH" />

The Kajidier clan played an important role in Hutt society by recruiting [[Gamorrean/Legends|Gamorreans]] from Gamorr to serve as security guards for the Hutt clans. Illegal activities that the clan was involved in included [[Slavery/Legends|slavery]], theft, [[Gambling/Legends|gambling]], [[Smuggler/Legends|smuggling]] and trading in [[Spice/Legends|spice]]. The clan also operated several legitimate businesses relating to [[Bodyguard/Legends|bodyguard]] and [[Mercenary/Legends|mercenary]] recruitment, foodstuffs and [[Droid/Legends|droids]].<ref name="LoNH" />

==History==
Though Kajidier was one of the ancient Hutt clans, it rarely held an influential position in Hutt society. During the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], the clan was led by the Hutt [[Jelpel]].<ref name="LoNH" />
